name: Open Targets Platform
scope: Integrated target-disease evidence. The 26.09 output has 61 datasets, including: credible_set, study, variant, colocalisation, l2g_prediction, enhancer_to_gene, baseline_expression, interaction, target_essentiality (DepMap), evidence_crispr/evidence_crispr_screen, evidence_impc, evidence_clingen, evidence_eva (ClinVar), evidence_gwas_credible_sets, evidence_gene_burden, evidence_genomics_england, evidence_uniprot_variants, pharmacogenomics, mouse_phenotype and reactome. The variant dataset states that all variation is mapped to GRCh38 with 1-based gnomAD-style identifiers (chrom_pos_ref_alt) and population allele frequencies from gnomAD 4.1.
mapping_methods: Evidence is mapped to Ensembl targets and EFO diseases by Open Targets pipelines; variant-level datasets keyed by GRCh38 coordinates (assembly not confirmed from the live evidence).

quantitative.summary: Association scores, credible-set posterior probabilities, colocalisation statistics, locus-to-gene scores, essentiality scores.
quantitative.uncertainty: credible-set PIPs and coloc posteriors where provided

licence.name: CC0 1.0 for Platform data (docs page); a separate data-source licensing list exists on the same page
licence.redistribution: CC0 for the Platform; upstream source terms should be checked from the data-source list

coverage_limitations: Aggregated and filtered by Open Targets rules; original studies may contain more detail
Datasets are large Parquet; only selected ones should be pulled
known_omissions: Rendered downloads page showed only 42 of the 61 datasets; the FTP listing is the complete inventory

reuse_decision.rationale: Already integrates GWAS credible sets, colocalisation, DepMap, CRISPR screens, IMPC, ClinGen, ClinVar (EVA) and pharmacogenomics. Use it as the primary route for those dimensions instead of scraping each source; keep the originals only where Open Targets omits information.

status.notes: FTP, GraphQL and docs reachable. A focused subset of 27 Parquet datasets (8.5 GiB) is acquired and validated; the large colocalisation (15.4 GiB), baseline_expression, literature and association-score datasets are deferred, 34 of the 61 datasets in all.

deferred.reason: Largest dataset (200 Parquet parts). Fetch when colocalisation of GWAS and molecular-QTL signals is needed for specific loci; it has no coordinate index, so it is read by full scan.
Tissue and cell-type expression; GTEx median TPM is already acquired directly.

deferred.item: association_* (6 datasets: by datasource/datatype/overall, direct and indirect)
deferred.reason: Derived target-disease association scores; recomputable from the evidence datasets and not variant-level.
Text-mining evidence; weak provenance for variant-level interpretation.

deferred.item: evidence_eva, evidence_eva_somatic, evidence_clingen, evidence_gwas_credible_sets, evidence_reactome, reactome, evidence_expression_atlas
deferred.reason: Re-expressions of ClinVar, ClinGen, GWAS credible sets and Reactome, which are acquired directly (credible_set is acquired in full).

deferred.item: cancer and drug datasets (evidence_cancer_biomarkers, evidence_cancer_gene_census, evidence_intogen, evidence_clinical_precedence, drug_molecule, drug_mechanism_of_action, drug_warning, clinical_indication, clinical_report, clinical_target, chemical_probe, target_tractability, target_safety_event, target_prioritisation, openfda_significant_adverse_drug_reactions)
deferred.reason: Somatic-cancer and drug-development content; outside germline genome interpretation for now.
Ensembl transcript table (29 MiB); the MANE summary already bridges Ensembl, RefSeq and HGNC identifiers for the joins in use. Fetch when transcript-level consequences are needed.
